project.title: Metagenomic sequencing of IFAS reactor under quorum-sensing signal molecule addition experiment
project.description: Whole-genome shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed for IFAS reactor sludge samples, to investigate the microbial community structure and functional gene response after exogenous quorum-sensing signal molecule supplementation. Samples include biofilm and suspended sludge under different signal-molecule treatment groups. Paired-end metagenomic sequencing (PE150) was applied on Illumina platform.
project.center_name: Tianjin University of Science and Technology
